title: Japanese-Style Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring fluffy rice, stir-fried vegetables, and a fried egg.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add broccoli and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced potatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Push vegetables to one side of the skillet.
Crack an egg into the other side of the skillet and scramble until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Pour soy sauce mixture over the egg and vegetable mixture.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
